# Let's check NCBI taxonomy for 9606
import urllib.request
import json

url = "https://rest.uniprot.org/taxonomy/9606.json"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    tax_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print("Taxon 9606 scientificName:", tax_data.get('scientificName'))
    print("Taxon 9606 commonName:", tax_data.get('commonName'))
